title: VisioVox artifact manifest
description: Playback payload returned by GET /projects/{id}/manifest (docs/11 §4). Emitted by S9 and by the mock pipeline; both are validated against this schema, which is what keeps the application and ML tracks buildable in parallel.

manifest_version.description: Frozen at 1.0 in Phase 1. A breaking change requires a new major version and a migration path, not an in-place edit.

duration_ms.description: Integer milliseconds. Media timing is never float seconds (invariant 2) — float accumulates error over long timelines.

overlap_ratio.description: Fraction of the timeline with more than one active speaker. Drives the single-talker passthrough decision (ADR-0010).

playback_hint.description: Server-chosen playback engine. Policy lives here rather than in the client so duration/track-count/byte thresholds are not duplicated (docs/12 §2).

warnings.description: Machine-readable, snake_case. Partial failure yields partial results (invariant 8), and this is how the UI explains what is missing.

signed_until.description: Expiry of the signed URLs in this document. The client refetches before this to avoid URLs expiring mid-playback.

allOf.description: has_video implies a video track is present.
HLS playback requires a master playlist to point at.

modality.description: Which streams were actually usable for this speaker. Reliability-gated fusion may fall back to audio_only (Novelty 2).

mean_confidence.description: Inference-time confidence (Novelty 5). Surfaced to the user rather than hidden — honest disclosure of uncertainty is a design principle.

extraction_ok.description: False means this speaker's track failed but the rest of the job succeeded. 2 of 3 speakers beats nothing (invariant 8).

faithful.description: The default track, and the one that gets transcribed (invariant 6). Generative restoration can hallucinate words.
